recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic blue portrait of a person with long, damp hair, captured from a low angle. The image features a distinct cyanotype aesthetic with grainy paper texture, deep Prussian blue shadows, and blown-out white highlights that suggest a solarized or chemical printing process.
coreVisualRelationships: Deep blue shadows against stark white negative space
Vertical flow of hair strands contrasting with the horizontal shoulder line
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance or introspection
Grainy, tactile paper texture integrated into the skin tones
coreInvariants: Heavy grain and paper fiber texture
High-contrast lighting with deep facial shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, framed from the chest up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, shadowed area around the eyes and nose serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical lines of the hair from the top of the head down to the shoulders, then back up to the facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounds the head and shoulders, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Prussian Blue (#003153) for mid-tones and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/Paper White for highlights and background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light Cerulean for transition areas and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with limited saturation variation; the blue remains deep and desaturated.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a person with long wet hair, using a monochromatic Prussian blue cyanotype style. Ensure high contrast with deep shadows on the face and a grainy, textured paper background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, thin-stroke sans-serif in white or a very light blue, positioned in the lower third to avoid obscuring the facial shadows.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue?
Is the paper texture visible in the highlights?
Is the angle low and the subject centered?

adjustableVariables: Length and texture of the hair
mustRedesign: Any color other than blue and white
postGenerationChecks: Check for Prussian blue shadow depth
Verify the presence of organic paper grain
Ensure the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the background is a clean, textured white
Ensure no other colors are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic cyanotype portrait + low angle + Prussian blue shadows + high contrast + grainy paper texture + wet hair detail.
